EU AI ACT 1/2: AI literacy requirement


               Providers and deployers of AI systems shall take measures to ensure,
               to their best extent, a sufficient level of AI literacy of their staff and
               other persons dealing with the operation and use of AI systems on
               their behalf,
               taking into account their technical knowledge, experience, education
               and training and the context the AI systems are to be used in, and
               considering the persons or groups of persons on whom the AI systems
               are to be used.
